snippet.title: Shopkeeper Simulator - Official Gameplay Trailer | STEAM
snippet.description:
🛒 Shopkeeper Simulator is coming to Steam - open and manage your own shop! 🏬 Sign up for the upcoming Playtest 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057580/Shopkeeper_Simulator/

Take on the role of a manager in the most addictive simulation game - open the doors to your store and build it from scratch, transforming a small shop into the ultimate supermarket! Become a great manager and make your store outstanding.
